description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification - 04/2020 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the notification of an order related to excise duties on ethyl alcohol, issued under the Excise Ordinance. It involves regulatory matters (duty rates, classifications) and legal framework (reference to specific sections of the Ordinance), making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it mentions a Minister and Secretary, it does not focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather on the regulatory content of the excise notification.
